Type: armless low-back task chair
Use: working at a desk; home office, bedroom, study
Style: minimalist, contemporary
Materials: black mesh fabric upholstery, padded foam, black plastic five-star base, casters
Colors: black
Shape: contoured padded back with lumbar stitching, armless, cushioned seat, height lever, five-star base on casters, compact and light
Feel: simple, practical, unobtrusive
Goes with: black or white desks, small rooms, neutral walls; modern or minimalist home offices

product.name: AmazonBasics Low-Back Task Chair with Swivel Casters - Black (Renewed)
product.description: Comfortable task chair upholstered in black fabric Padded seat and back for all-day comfort and support Pneumatic seat-height adjustment; 360-degree swivel; smooth-rolling casters 250-pound maximum weight capacity; assembly instructions included Measures 25.2 by 18.7 by 34.6 to 37.8 inches (LxWxH); 1-year limited warranty
